summary: Preserve all four merge-queue test partitions in conditional post-merge hosted proof

rules.detail: Post-merge proof builds queue-equivalent jobs, runner selection and four test partitions while retaining the real main-push event for evidence, signing and cache authority. Queue-ref cancellation and PR-only advice are omitted.

compatibility.detail: Ordinary fleet generation is unchanged. Signed merge-group reuse remains disabled pending separate activation.

manual.detail: Red post-merge hosted proof still requests a human revert; no automatic revert.

recovery.detail: Leave merge_group mode off until complete hosted proof is deployed.
